content.short: Rigoblock provides non-custodial smart pools for asset management by humans and agents.
content.description: Rigoblock offers non-custodial asset management through smart pools: on-chain vehicles where a manager runs a strategy while depositors keep control of their funds. It explicitly targets both human managers and automated agents. It is deployed on Unichain, where DefiLlama tracks its pools.
content.meta: Rigoblock provides non-custodial smart pools for asset management by humans and agents, including on Unichain.
